capabilities: Collapse cards and sections and dim non-focused content
Search the canvas, align selections and show a minimap
Export cards, sections or selections as 2x PNG
Build SVG mindmaps and slice cards by date
extras: Bilingual README (English and Simplified Chinese) with a linked demo video but no written usage instructions; notes are stored in standard .canvas files.
intentEvidence: Heptabase-style visual thinking for native Obsidian Canvas
problem: Obsidian Canvas has no card styling, section folding, focus, in-canvas search or alignment tools, so large boards are hard to read and navigate.

relations.evidence: Heptabase-style visual thinking for native Obsidian Canvas

summary: Canvas toolkit adding tinted cards, collapsible sections, focus mode, in-canvas search, minimap, alignment and mindmaps.
